baseline_models.focus_anchor: The initial lam makes the indefinite yawm a destination or purpose, while azim qualifies the occasion itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name more than a date: a severe event-time toward which an unstated action is directed. The day is the befalling occasion, and its greatness is force and gravity.

activation_trace.role: The event-day and severe-occasion image turns time from a container into the occurrence that is approached.
The greatness-and-strength image gives the destination-day operative force rather than decorative grandeur.
The grave-calamity image keeps severity as a live specification of what makes the occasion great.

changed_reading.before: A generically great future date.
changed_reading.after: A forceful event-time functioning as the destination of the phrase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yawm can denote an open duration, and azim can evoke the bulk or greater part of something.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two words can dilate together: the focus may point to an epoch-like span whose greatness is temporal extent or comprehensiveness, not only intensity at one instant.

activation_trace.role: The open-span image releases yawm from a strict sunrise-to-sunset boundary.
The bulk-or-greater-part image renders greatness as extension and inclusion.

changed_reading.before: One large calendar day.
changed_reading.after: An encompassing span whose magnitude may lie in how much it gathers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The event sense of yawm combines with the branch of azim in which something looms overwhelming in the perceiver.
baseline_models.mechanism: Greatness is relational: the occasion exceeds the reader's ordinary scale of apprehension. The focus therefore stages an encounter that overwhelms, not merely an object with an intrinsic size.

activation_trace.role: The severe-occurrence image supplies the encountered event.
The finding-something-overwhelming image locates greatness in the event's effect on apprehension.

changed_reading.before: A day described from outside as important.
changed_reading.after: An occasion experienced from within as too consequential to contain mentally.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Azim carries both genuine social standing and blameworthy self-magnification, while yawm can be a notable affair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can open an arena in which greatness itself is contested: real honor and inflated self-importance coexist as rival possibilities awaiting separation.

activation_trace.role: The notable-affair image supplies a public occasion on which standing can change.
The honor-and-standing image makes social rank a literal dimension of greatness.
The self-magnifying image introduces counterfeit greatness as the standing branch's live rival.

changed_reading.before: A day with a fixed, undifferentiated grandeur.
changed_reading.after: An event-field in which true standing and self-inflation may be exposed and reassigned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A bounded day is modified by a root whose inventory also contains thick bodily members and hard bone.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material reading flickers beneath the adjective: the time-boundary can be imagined as a thick, load-bearing frame rather than an empty interval. This is form-distant but remains attached to both focus roots.

activation_trace.role: The bounded daylight image supplies a definite temporal frame.
The thick-part image gives the frame bodily bulk and load-bearing capacity.
The hard-bone image supplies structural solidity to the otherwise abstract interval.

changed_reading.before: Time as an empty interval with a strong adjective.
changed_reading.after: A bounded temporal structure imagined as thick enough to bear what will occur within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination-day becomes a countermeasure to asymmetric exchange. Exact measuring, demanded completeness, just balance, and imposed shortfall make its greatness totalizing: every withheld fraction can be gathered back into one settlement.

activation_trace.role: The event-day image lets the focus operate as the settlement event rather than merely its date.
The bulk image makes greatness the gathered total against many small depletions.
The concrete food-measure image supplies the transaction template that the day scales up.
The complete-without-defect image specifies the full amount the final countermeasure restores.
The balance-of-justice image converts measuring from quantity alone into normative equivalence.
The shorting-of-measure image names the deficit that the great settlement gathers and reverses.

structural_cues: 83:1 supplies the branchless ط ف ف cue as the heading for a repeated receive-full/give-less asymmetry.
83:2-3 reverse grammatical participants while retaining the same measuring field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: asymmetrical measure, completeness, just balance, and induced loss. Reader arrow: the destination-day remeasures the accumulated deficit and returns it to settlement. Live alternative: the measuring scene only identifies an offense punished on an otherwise generic great day.

changed_reading.before: A severe destination after dishonest exchange.
changed_reading.after: The comprehensive counter-scale on which every deliberately missing fraction becomes present again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus day becomes a threshold that changes state: signs can move thought between doubt and warranted certainty, while sending or raising stirs what was still. Its greatness lies partly in activation power.

activation_trace.role: The event-day image receives a state-changing function rather than remaining a timestamp.
The overwhelming image explains why the threshold should already alter present apprehension.
The doubt-and-supposition image supplies the unstable mental state before activation.
The certainty-after-an-indication image preserves a live route by which the same root can harden expectation.
The stirring-of-the-still image gives the day its literal transition from latency to motion.

structural_cues: The question in 83:4 places a present mental act beside a future passive raising, immediately before the lam phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a question about supposition and an image of stirring stillness. Reader arrow: the focus day is the activating threshold that should affect certainty before it arrives. Live alternative: raising merely occurs on that date without the day itself carrying causal force.

changed_reading.before: A remote date that one may or may not believe in.
changed_reading.after: A latent-to-active threshold whose anticipated force can already convert mere supposition into consequential certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant hard-frame baseline becomes functional when bodily standing, collective humanity, and sovereignty meet. The great day can be pictured as a skeletal axis that erects and aligns a dispersed public before a single authority.

activation_trace.role: The bounded-day image supplies the common frame within which the assembly stands.
The hard-bone image gives the temporal frame its deliberately exploratory skeletal structure.
The bodily-standing image turns the skeleton analogy into an enacted vertical posture.
The resurrection-and-rising image scales bodily posture into the event's collective transition.
The manifest-human image supplies the public body that becomes visible and aligned.
The sovereignty image supplies the authority before which the aligned body stands.

structural_cues: 83:6 repeats yawm and immediately predicates standing of all people toward one lordship relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: bounded day, hard bone, bodily rising, manifest humanity, and sovereignty. Reader arrow: these form a load-bearing public axis. Live alternative: the body branches are ordinary lexical echoes and the day remains only the time of standing.

changed_reading.before: A hard but still abstract temporal boundary.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory load-bearing day that erects and aligns the human collective before authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rupture is not allowed to disperse: joining into a register, enrollment, marking, and confinement turn deeds into a durable locating system. The day's bulk can be the density of what it has gathered and fixed.

activation_trace.role: The event-day image lets the archive become operative at a decisive occasion.
The bulk image makes accumulated entries, not visual grandeur, one source of magnitude.
The enrollment-in-a-register image links inscription to placement in a class or record.
The breaking-through-a-cover image supplies the rupturing conduct that the archive refuses to let vanish.
The confinement image makes recorded classification spatially binding.
The marked-line-in-a-register image gives the enclosure a durable evidentiary trace.

structural_cues: 83:7-9 move from a possessed record to a confining location, then restate the record as marked.
The compact nominal clause in 83:9 makes record and marking mutually defining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: rupture, enrollment, a marked record, and confinement. Reader arrow: inscription locates and holds the doer, making the day an operative archive. Live alternative: the record is only evidence and the confinement is an independent destination.

changed_reading.before: A great catastrophe that follows misconduct.
changed_reading.after: A juridical event in which dispersed acts become a dense, marked archive capable of locating and enclosing their agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated yawm is explicitly coupled to accounting and returned consequence. Denial, boundary-crossing, and delay from good become relational imbalances, so the great day is not random disaster but the maturation of an account.

activation_trace.role: The severe-event image provides the occasion whose function is now specified as accounting.
The force image makes the accounting consequential rather than merely descriptive.
The attribution-to-falsehood image shows an attempted cancellation of the account by relabeling it.
The repeated event-day image explicitly reconnects the later accounting phrase to the focus.
The accounting-and-recompense image names the relational operation performed by the day.
The crossing-the-limit image supplies the breached boundary that calls for reckoning.
The delay-from-good image recasts wrongdoing as an arrear that remains outstanding.

structural_cues: 83:11 repeats yawm in an annexed construction whose second term specifies the day's operation.
83:12 shifts from denial of the day to the recurring character of the denier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: event-day, accounting, denial, limit-crossing, and delay. Reader arrow: these are one maturing account rather than unrelated labels. Live alternative: day of accounting is simply a conventional title and the character terms only identify its rejecters.

changed_reading.before: A powerful external calamity.
changed_reading.after: The forceful maturation of breached relations into an account that can no longer be deferred or renamed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs meet an inward system that repeatedly reverses or coats perception; what the limbs acquire consolidates into a no-exit state, and inward occlusion becomes outward prevention of access. The day is great as the threshold at which a cultivated interior becomes an imposed spatial relation.

activation_trace.role: The event-day image supplies the threshold where inward condition becomes outward placement.
The overwhelming image renders the state conversion experientially grave without reducing it to size.
The manifest-sign image supplies perceptible evidence available before the closing state.
The falling-into-a-state-with-no-exit image gives accumulated occlusion its trapping topology.
The turning-a-thing-from-its-face image models the inward reversal that makes a visible sign unreadable.
The acquiring-limbs image locates the repeated inputs in embodied action rather than passive ignorance.
The prevention-of-access image converts inward blockage into an external relation of exclusion.

structural_cues: 83:13-15 sequence visible recitation, acquired coating, then blocked access.
The repeated corrective kalla marks two successive reversals of the denier's description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: visible signs, a no-exit coating, bodily acquisition, inward turning, and denied access. Reader arrow: repeated action converts self-occlusion into external exclusion on the focus day. Live alternative: the inward and outward barriers are separate consequences with no developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: A day overwhelming because of what arrives from outside.
changed_reading.after: A threshold where an acquired inner barrier becomes a concrete inability to reach what had been repeatedly screened out.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mirrored records occupy opposed spatial values: confinement below and enrollment in elevation. The day's greatness is therefore amplitude and discriminating capacity, not a single emotional climate shared by everyone.

activation_trace.role: The major-event image supplies one occasion capable of holding opposed outcomes.
The magnitude image becomes the vertical span across which the event differentiates.
The confinement image establishes the downward or closed pole of the contrast.
The enrollment image makes the positive record a placement relation parallel to the earlier record.
The truth carried through word and act supplies the conduct associated with upward placement.
The elevation image establishes the open upper pole against confinement.

structural_cues: 83:7 and 83:18 use closely mirrored record-in-location clauses for opposed groups.
83:8 and 83:19 repeat the same question formula around the two locations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mirrored records, confinement, truthful action, and elevation. Reader arrow: the focus day's greatness is the amplitude of its sorting field. Live alternative: the locations describe separate destinations and do not modify how azim is heard.

changed_reading.before: A uniformly terrible day.
changed_reading.after: One immense differentiating event whose greatness includes the full span between enclosure and elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Presence, privileged nearness, mutual visibility, recognition by marks, the public face, and radiance make standing legible. The focus day does not merely possess greatness; it exposes which greatness is real and allows status to be read without self-assertion.

activation_trace.role: The public event-day image supplies the occasion of manifestation.
The social-standing image makes publicly reassigned rank a direct focus anchor.
The presence-with-seeing image gives the record an attending public rather than hidden storage.
The favored-near-ones image supplies recognized standing close to authority.
The mutual-facing image turns rank into a visible social relation.
The recognition-by-trace image supplies the act of reading status from an effect.
The prestige image makes the face a social surface on which standing appears.
The radiance image supplies the visible effect by which favorable standing is recognized.

structural_cues: 83:21-24 move from witnessed record to observers, then to a face whose condition can be recognized.
The second-person recognition verb makes legibility available to an onlooker, not only to insiders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: witnessed presence, favored nearness, facing, recognition, prestige, and radiance. Reader arrow: these are the day making true rank publicly legible. Live alternative: visible delight follows an already completed judgment and does not define the day's greatness.

changed_reading.before: A day declared great by an authoritative adjective.
changed_reading.after: A day that demonstrates greatness by making concealed moral standing publicly readable in records, proximity, and faces.

context_deltas.mechanism: A selected drink is securely closed, ends in a recognizable scent, is deliberately mixed, and traces to an elevated spring. Against the earlier corrupt measure, integrity is not isolation or unmixed sameness; it is controlled composition with intact custody and provenance.

activation_trace.role: The event-day image lets the later gift economy revise the earlier punitive settlement model.
The greatness image shifts from sheer total quantity to the quality and integrity of an ordered whole.
The selected-clear-drink image supplies a valued substance whose integrity matters.
The secured-preventive-seal image supplies intact custody against adulteration or loss.
The musk image makes the ending itself a sensory signature of the contents.
The mixing image prevents integrity from being reduced to unmixed purity.
The elevation image supplies the mixture's declared source hierarchy.
The flowing-spring image gives the composition traceable provenance rather than anonymous dilution.

structural_cues: 83:25-28 progress from sealed vessel to ending, mixture, source, and drinkers.
The seal and mixture coexist in adjacent descriptions rather than canceling each other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: selected drink, secure seal, scented ending, deliberate mixture, elevation, and spring source. Reader arrow: together they model protected composition, revising the earlier economy of corrupt measure. Live alternative: these are independent luxury images with no return to the weighing frame.

changed_reading.before: The great day as a countermeasure that only restores exact quantities.
changed_reading.after: A transformed economy in which wholeness includes measured mixture, secure custody, and knowable source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bounded daylight baseline is reactivated by breath as the opening of dawn and relief of constriction, then by a flowing source. The same great day that closes around some can open and make room for others; greatness can include release and renewed capacity.

activation_trace.role: The sunrise-to-sunset image supplies the day whose beginning can be heard as an opening.
The strength image permits greatness to mean enlarged capacity rather than terror alone.
The dawn-opening-like-breath image directly links temporal beginning with expansion.
The relief-of-constriction image gives the opening an affective and spatial effect.
The precious-object-of-competition image ties expanded capacity to directed desire rather than passive comfort.
The flowing-source image prevents the opened day from remaining a purely psychological metaphor.

structural_cues: The imperative to compete in 83:26 interrupts static enjoyment with forward-directed striving.
83:28 ends the drink sequence at an open source rather than a closed vessel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: competition, breath-like dawn, relief, and a flowing source. Reader arrow: these activate the bounded focus day as opening and increased room for life. Live alternative: nafs contributes only desire for a precious reward, while dawn and breath remain remote branch play.

changed_reading.before: A bounded day great chiefly because it bears calamity.
changed_reading.after: A bifacial day that can also dawn, breathe open, and release constriction into directed abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mocking visibility is not neutral: laughter marks a hierarchy, repeated turning carries it home, and an explicit denial of guardianship exposes the gaze as unauthorized judgment. On the later 'today,' subject and object reverse. The focus day's greatness is power to reassign who has standing to look, name, and laugh.

activation_trace.role: The notable-event image supplies the hinge on which social positions reverse.
The honor-and-standing image makes prestige reversal a direct specification of greatness.
The offense image identifies the social performance as culpable action, not incidental amusement.
The visible opening of the face and teeth makes hierarchy publicly performed through laughter.
The turning-from-one-face image makes the doubled return home a rehearsal for larger reversal.
The guarding-and-supervision image defines the authority the mockers were not given.
The repeated event-day marks the explicit temporal hinge where the laughing subject changes.
The facing-and-seeing image gives the newly assigned observers a stable relational position.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 repeat laughter with the two groups exchanging grammatical roles.
83:23 and 83:35 repeat the same couch-and-looking line, tying observation to the reversal.
83:33 interrupts hostile observation by denying that the observers were appointed guardians.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: culpable laughter, doubled turning, denied guardianship, repeated today, and later looking. Reader arrow: the day reallocates social authority and visible standing, not only pleasure and pain. Live alternative: the reversal is simple recompense without a broader critique of unauthorized judgment.

changed_reading.before: A public occasion on which preexisting rank is announced.
changed_reading.after: The hinge that reverses a manufactured hierarchy and redistributes the authority to observe, classify, and display joy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question makes recompense a return from action to actor. Covering may defer recognition, but enacted work is present in time and completes a circuit. The great day is not only when a verdict arrives; it is the return path by which doing reaches its doer.

activation_trace.role: The decisive-event image becomes the point at which the causal circuit closes.
The force image gives returned consequence enough power to overturn prior asymmetry.
The consequence-returning-to-its-worker image supplies the explicit return circuit.
The covering image explains how the action-consequence relation could be screened without being canceled.
The occurrence-present-in-time image gives past doing durable temporal presence.
The bringing-an-act-into-being image supplies the originating action that returns.

structural_cues: The final question places recompense before the relative clause of what they used to do, folding outcome back onto action.
The imperfect habit construction preserves repeated doing as the source material of the return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: returned recompense, covering, temporal occurrence, and enacted work. Reader arrow: consequence travels back along an action-shaped circuit and the focus day closes it. Live alternative: recompense is externally assigned and only proportionate to acts, not a return generated through them.

changed_reading.before: A future container in which recompense is delivered.
changed_reading.after: The powerful closure-point where actions return through time to the agents who brought them into being.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates azim through a concrete appearance-enlarging pad and links denial, covering, and recompense through garment branches. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and in a packet-wide material sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as an analogy of manufactured appearance being replaced by an action-fitted exterior, never as the lexical translation of azim or the named garments.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ع ظ م includes both blameworthy self-enlargement and literal padding that produces an enlarged appearance.

activation_trace.role: The appearance-enlarging pad image supplies a concrete model of greatness fabricated by added exterior volume.
The arrogant-self-magnifying image gives the padding analogy its social and moral target.
The garment-that-lies-by-its-condition image makes false presentation materially visible.
The covering image supplies the broader operation by which true condition is hidden.
The garment-and-clothing image lets returned recompense be imagined as an exterior newly fitted to the self.

changed_reading.before: A day great in the same way that powerful people appear great.
changed_reading.after: A material truth test that exposes padded greatness and replaces deceptive appearance with an action-fitted condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant mapped root ر و ي under the packet's ر ء ي cue, so it is mapping-driven and unusually branch-distant. It remains worth carrying because 83:32 immediately converts seeing into a spoken verdict about others' status, while the focus has a social-standing branch. Downstream prose should qualify it as a possible activation of gaze producing narrative, not claim that the surface verb means narrate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The notable focus day and the social-standing branch of azim can host a contest over who gets to describe another group's rank.

activation_trace.role: The notable-event image supplies the occasion on which rival social descriptions are adjudicated.
The honor-and-standing image anchors the rival narration in the focus adjective's social dimension.
The report-and-poetry narration image activates the possibility that hostile sight is converted into a story about its object.
The saying-what-was-not image makes the spoken classification a potentially fabricated account.
The disappearance-and-hiddenness image shows the hostile story making its targets' actual standing vanish from view.

changed_reading.before: A great day that corrects an incorrect opinion.
changed_reading.after: A day that breaks the authority of narratives manufactured when a hostile gaze turns immediately into social classification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-connects bone, bodily standing, joining, marks on an animal body, and acquiring limbs into a skeletal ledger. Every piece is branch-backed and the hard-bone anchor is inside the focus, but the packet does not state that the body itself is the record. Downstream prose should retain it only as an embodied-record analogy and foreground that the identity between body and archive is reader-supplied.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hard-bone branch of ع ظ م allows the adjective to carry an exploratory bodily substrate inside the focus phrase.

activation_trace.role: The hard-bone image supplies the load-bearing bodily surface of the analogy.
The bodily-standing image brings that substrate into public presentation.
The joining-one-thing-to-another image lets discrete acts be assembled into an embodied record.
The marked-traces-on-an-animal-body image supplies a literal bridge between inscription and body.
The acquiring-limbs image makes bodily action the proposed source of the marks.

changed_reading.before: People stand on the great day beside an external record.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the standing body itself can be heard as a joined and marked record of what its limbs acquired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because two context branches independently place balance and standing at midday, then a thick bodily branch is used as a load-bearing plumb line. The focus yawm supplies the temporal anchor, so the convergence is not free association; nevertheless downstream prose should call it a branch resonance, not a claim that the verse specifies noon or a physical scale.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bounded-day branch of yawm and thick-member branch of azim permit a compact time-body geometry.

activation_trace.role: The bounded daylight image supplies a day with a center rather than an indefinite future span.
The thick-member image supplies a load-bearing vertical axis for the material analogy.
The balance-of-day-at-its-middle image fuses temporal midpoint with equilibrium.
The standing-midday image independently supplies verticality at the day's balance point.

changed_reading.before: A great day containing a weighing and a standing.
changed_reading.after: A branch-resonant day imagined as the poised balance point where temporal midpoint and upright standing become one plumb geometry.

strongest_changes: The day shifted from a passive future date to a countermeasure, account, and return circuit that gathers withheld differences and sends acts back to their agents.
Greatness shifted from uniform terror to discriminating amplitude: enclosure and elevation, occlusion and access, false prestige and publicly legible standing coexist within one event.
The positive drink sequence revised exactness into integrity with custody, provenance, and ordered mixture rather than mere unmixed quantity.
Late reversals made social gaze and unauthorized classification part of what the day overturns, not just background behavior.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus remained unusually elastic: yawm moved among bounded daylight, open duration, and event, while azim moved among force, bulk, overwhelm, status, bodily solidity, and fabricated enlargement. Context did not collapse those branches; it activated distinct measuring, archival, vertical, perceptual, social, and material mechanisms that can coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from dishonest measure to comprehensive settlement, and from inner occlusion to outer exclusion, are abductive rather than explicitly supplied.
Vertical sorting and public legibility may describe consequences occurring on the day rather than dimensions of what makes the day azim.
Bone, padding, bodily marking, midday geometry, and the non-dominant narration mapping are deliberately form-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
The breath-and-dawn reading may overactivate remote nafs branches even though it productively preserves the day's positive opening alongside severity.
